title: Subarrays with sum k
statement:
Count the contiguous subarrays of an array whose elements add up to exactly k. Elements can be negative.

Input: the first line holds n and k (1 <= n <= 200000, -10^9 <= k <= 10^9). The second line holds n integers a_1 .. a_n (-10^4 <= a_i <= 10^4).
Output: one line with the number of pairs (i, j), 1 <= i <= j <= n, such that a_i + a_(i+1) + ... + a_j = k. The answer can be larger than 2^31.

An O(n^2) solution is too slow for the largest tests.

Example
Input:
5 3
1 2 1 -1 3
Output:
5
(the subarrays are [1 2], [2 1], [1 2 1 -1], [1 -1 3] and [3])
